category: PACS Loan Disbursement Delay or Denial
description: Farmer applied for short-term KCC loan at local PACS but application is pending beyond 15 working days without legitimate cause.
primary_officer: Secretary / Chief Executive Officer, Local PACS
first_escalation: Assistant Registrar of Cooperative Societies (ARCS) / District Central Cooperative Bank (DCCB) Branch Manager
second_escalation: Deputy Registrar of Cooperative Societies (DRCS) / Cooperative Ombudsman
required_documents: Copy of submitted loan application with date acknowledgment
statutory_timeline: 15 days for first response; 30 days for resolution under Cooperative Citizen Charter

category: PMFBY Crop Insurance Claim Rejection / Delay
description: Farmer suffered crop loss due to hailstorm or localized flooding, intimated within 72 hours, but claim was rejected or payout unpaid past 45 days.
primary_officer: District Agriculture Officer (DAO) / Insurance Nodal Officer
first_escalation: District Level Grievance Redressal Committee (DGRC) headed by District Magistrate (DM/Collector)
second_escalation: State Level Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC) / National Crop Insurance Portal Grievance Desk
required_documents: PMFBY Insurance Policy / Receipt / Application ID
Surveyor joint inspection report copy (if conducted)
Bank Account statement showing premium deduction
statutory_timeline: DGRC must adjudicate claim dispute within 15 days of filing

description: Local PACS managing committee refused or delayed farmer membership application without written reasons.
second_escalation: State Cooperative Tribunal / Minister of Cooperation Public Grievance Portal
required_documents: Membership application copy with share capital receipt or postal delivery slip
Residence certificate or Land document in the village
Written refusal letter (if issued by PACS)
statutory_timeline: ARCS will inspect society records within 21 days and order deemed membership if criteria met
